title: Pure Tri-Brigade
summary: Tri-Brigade cards with generic staples; the page's Branded Fusion and Springans hybrids are left out. Each Tri-Brigade monster banishes Beasts, Beast-Warriors and Winged Beasts from the GY to summon a Link of that rating straight from the Extra Deck, and most of them search, mill or summon again when they hit the GY. Tri-Brigade Hammer searches the Spells/Traps or summons a Tri-Brigade Link the same way, and Arms Mouser mills two Tri-Brigade cards. Tri-Brigade Springans Kitt, the newest card, summons itself next to a Tri-Brigade and revives one when it goes to the GY. The Extra Deck is all Beast-type Links because those effects lock you into them for the turn.

Tri-Brigade Hammer
2025 support. Searches a Tri-Brigade Spell/Trap, or banishes to summon a Tri-Brigade Link.
Tri-Brigade Stand-Off

Tri-Brigade Airborne Assault

Tri-Brigade Rendezvous
Pumps and protects your linked Beasts.
Tri-Brigade Revolt

Tri-Brigade Oath
Summons a Beast of a new Type next to a Link.
